notes: This phase advances UX-24.5 and shared persistence/loading evidence; it does not close staff review, batch-progress, the complete site matrix, or any external browser/device/human gate. No new whole criterion is marked passed from this narrower scope.

The original Campaigns entry opened a Promotions H2 and a long phone form. The shared H1, saved-campaign picker and review/offer jumps now expose the workflow consistently. All six supported formats remain available in one native selector; export rendering/business rules are unchanged.

The first delayed-save sample was too late to establish the exact overlap. Use exact-overlap-request-boundary: two requests received, one completed, newest text present and Saving draft. Periodic active-time bookkeeping can create additional serialized requests; do not treat every later request as a duplicate content submission.

Same-URL goto did not establish a fresh document. Use campaign-fresh-document-restored-description and campaign-final-fresh-* query-distinct navigations for reopen and fresh-load proof. The initial loading profile did not trigger against cached assets and is not loading evidence.

A fresh document exposed overflow from the fieldset/grid sizing. This was fixed with a separate fieldset and grid wrapper plus zero-minimum tracks. Earlier responsive views and size-error captures are historical; final-fresh widths and final-size-error-after-grid-fix-320 are authoritative.

Early geometry collection included closed-details descendants with reported rectangles; those entries are not visibility evidence. Final collection excludes closed details and hidden ancestors. Full-page focus text from early samples was discarded; it is not used as evidence.

Native tool clicks can scroll the page before activation, and early jump samples used smooth scrolling. Compare document positions (top plus scrollY) for loading/retry geometry. Final keyboard jumps use immediate scrolling and visibly focus the intended heading below the fixed phone navigation.

The temporary campaign-preview-fixture.jpg is an unapproved copy of an existing local JPEG. It forced a real 503 and delayed successful image retry. The original selected photo and description were restored; the temporary asset was removed. No paid generation, caption generation, approval, promotion publication, purchase or outbound message occurred. The allowance remains 5 and the fixture retains 12 active dishes.

The empty/start and gated approval/publish/export outcomes are not asserted as complete UI walkthroughs here. Existing application regressions cover promotion business rules; actual browser-delivered file and full task-flow gates remain open.
Current profile is clear, temporary gateway stopped, and browser returned to localhost:5173. No deployment occurred.
